content: ## Voting Tally  **Voter panel**: Voter 1 (Claude Code Reviewer subagent, opus), Voter 2 (Codex), Voter 3 (Cursor)  **Voter eligibility**: - Voter 1 (Claude): eligible (inline) - Voter 2 (Codex): ineligible — direct `codex exec` invocation did not produce output (stdin hang; not launched via `run-external-agent.sh`) - Voter 3 (Cursor): ineligible — `run-external-agent.sh` returned exit code 0 with no output; `.diag` shows "Process exited successfully but produced no output"  **Result**: Only 1 eligible voter. Per threshold rules, 2+ YES is required and <2 eligible voters means skip. No findings formally accepted by vote.  **Editorial revisions**: Despite the voter infrastructure failure, the review panel findings (9 of 10 external reviewers returned valid output) were substantive and high-quality. The plan has been editorially revised to address the most critical findings (FINDING_1 through FINDING_16) as improvements. These revisions are recorded in `rejected-findings.md` for auditability but are reflected in the final plan.  | Finding | Claude (V1) | Codex (V2) | Cursor (V3) | Formal Result | Editorial Action | |---------|-------------|-----------|------------|---------------|------------------| | FINDING_1 | YES | ineligible | ineligible | unaccepted (<2 eligible) | Applied — eval replaced with safe parsing | | FINDING_2 | YES | ineligible | ineligible | unaccepted | Applied — flat batch slug layout clarified | | FINDING_3 | YES | ineligible | ineligible | unaccepted | Applied — substantive-validation required | | FINDING_4 | YES | ineligible | ineligible | unaccepted | Applied — dirty-tree + read-only contract added | | FINDING_5 | YES | ineligible | ineligible | unaccepted | Applied — CI pin migration specified | ...
